name: Aran
source:
Aran is always there, somewhere by the distance. He's an expressionless and enigmatic character who is incapable of showing even the tiniest glint of emotion. He is a fleeting existence and a mere spectator to everything that happens around him. He doesn't seem to belong to the village and may suddenly appear out of nowhere.

[from [url=http://hinoyabu.wordpress.com/2013/08/26/blue-rose-characters-aran/]Creator's blog[/url]]
